title: My whole order was disappointing.
text: My whole order was disappointing.. I bought more Jumbo muffin tins and thought the paper liners and boxes were also jumbo because they where called Large.  There are 3 size of muffins, minis, standard, and jumbos (or large).  So imagine my disappointment when i found I didn't have liners or boxes for my muffin tins. Because I do make standard size muffins/cup cakes I will keep these boxes and the paper liners.  Very disappointed.
